children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
What pods are compatible with Uwell Caliburn kits?
Uwell Caliburn pods are
model-specific

: the Uwell Caliburn Ironfist L Empty Replacement Pod fits the Uwell Caliburn & Ironfist L kit only. The Caliburn G, G2, GK2, GZ2, Koko Prime, Tenet, Explorer and Caliburn X each have their own pod shape, though all of them share the same Uwell Caliburn G and G2 coils.
Are Caliburn G and G2 pods the same?
No. Uwell Caliburn G and G2 pods are
different shapes

and neither fits the Uwell Caliburn & Ironfist L. What they do share is the coil: Uwell Caliburn G 0.8Ω and 1.0Ω coils and Caliburn G2 1.2Ω coils press-fit into all three pods, so one coil pack covers every kit in the family.
How long do Uwell Caliburn pods last?
An Uwell Caliburn Ironfist L Empty Replacement Pod lasts
weeks to months

because the coil is the part that wears, usually after 7 to 10 days of average use. Replace the pod itself when the mouthpiece cracks, the side plug no longer seals, or it keeps leaking after a fresh, properly primed coil.
Is 1.0 or 0.8 coil better for the Uwell Caliburn Ironfist L?
It depends on the draw you want. The
Uwell Caliburn G 1.0Ω
gives a tight, cigarette-like MTL pull on nic salts; the
0.8Ω mesh
runs warmer and looser with more flavour. The Caliburn G2 1.2Ω coil fitted in the kit is tighter still and uses the least battery.
What are common problems with Uwell Caliburn pods?
Three recur.
Leaking
: usually overfilling or a coil not pushed fully home, so leave an air gap and seat it flush.
Burnt taste
: a coil fired before its 5 to 10 minute soak.
Not firing
: the pod is not clicked onto its magnets or the coil has lost contact; refit both.
Does the Uwell Caliburn Ironfist L pod hold 2ml or 2.5ml?
Both figures are correct for different markets. Uwell rates the Caliburn & Ironfist L pod at
2.5ml
, but pods sold in the UK are limited to
2ml
under TPD rules, so that is the usable fill you should expect here. Either way it is roughly a day of moderate vaping per fill.
